result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 2 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # The separator is the all-4 horizontal/vertical cross.
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    vr=next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==4 for r in range(h)))
    hr=next(r for r in range(h) if all(x==4 for x in grid[r]))
    out=[]
    for r in range(hr):
        row=[]
        for c in range(vr):
            # overlay priority: lower-right, upper-left, upper-right, lower-left
            vals=(grid[hr+1+r][vr+1+c], grid[r][c], grid[r][vr+1+c], grid[hr+1+r][c])
            row.append(next((x for x in vals if x!=0),0))
        out.append(row)
    return out"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # The full-color cross divides four equal-sized panels.  At each
    # corresponding position, paint the result with the first nonzero
    # mark in the order southeast, northwest, northeast, southwest.
    rows=len(grid); cols=len(grid[0])
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(x==4 for x in r)]
    cs=[j for j in range(cols) if all(grid[i][j]==4 for i in range(rows))]
    r0,r1=rs[0],rs[-1]; c0,c1=cs[0],cs[-1]
    H=r0; W=c0
    out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        row=[]
        for j in range(W):
            vals=[grid[r1+1+i][c1+1+j], grid[i][j], grid[i][c1+1+j], grid[r1+1+i][j]]
            row.append(next((v for v in vals if v!=0),0))
        out.append(row)
    return out"}
